name: eUPF
description: Open-source 5G User Plane Function using eBPF technology for high-performance packet forwarding. Supports N3 (GTP-U), N4 (PFCP), and N6 interfaces with Prometheus metrics.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker image at ghcr.io/edgecomllc/eupf:main. Run: sudo docker run -d --rm --privileged -v /sys/fs/bpf:/sys/fs/bpf -p 8080 -p 9090 ghcr.io/edgecomllc/eupf:main

eval_notes: eBPF-based UPF with 164 stars. Supports FAR, QER, SDF filters. Compatible with Free5GC, Open5GS, OAI. High-performance PFCP/GTP-U processing ideal for user plane evaluation scenarios.
